_what: List prices in USD per 1M tokens, global endpoint, Standard tier, used to turn token counts into dollars per task.
_check_before_use: Prices change. Gemini 3.8 Flash has introductory pricing through 2026-12-31 and Gemini 4 Argon has promotional pricing through 2026-11-30. Copy the current numbers from the pricing page before you trust any dollar figure. Claude prices are the Agent Platform partner-model prices (global, up to 200K input tokens; 5-minute cache writes).
